upgrades.name: Sharpened Claws
upgrades.desc: Your claws rake what is ahead, harder and wider.

upgrades.name: Thick Hide
upgrades.desc: More health.

upgrades.name: Long Stride
upgrades.desc: Move faster.

upgrades.name: Heavy Steps
upgrades.desc: Stomps reach further.

upgrades.name: Endless Rage
upgrades.desc: Rampages last longer.

upgrades.name: Armoured Scales
upgrades.desc: Each army hit does less damage.

upgrades.name: Hoarder
upgrades.desc: Devour more of what you flatten.

upgrades.name: Frenzy
upgrades.desc: Stomp more often.

upgrades.name: EVOLVE: Behemoth
upgrades.desc: Grow huge. Tear through towers faster.

upgrades.name: Signature Power
upgrades.desc: Your signature attack hits harder.

upgrades.name: Regeneration
upgrades.desc: Slowly heal while rampaging.

upgrades.name: Signature Recharge
upgrades.desc: Use your signature attack more often.

upgrades.name: Crushing Weight
upgrades.desc: Much stronger stomps.

upgrades.name: Titan Hide
upgrades.desc: Much more health.

upgrades.name: EVOLVE: Colossus
upgrades.desc: Grow enormous. Topple skyscrapers.

upgrades.name: Signature Reach
upgrades.desc: Your signature attack covers more ground.

upgrades.name: Apex Predator
upgrades.desc: Devastating stomps.

upgrades.name: Adrenaline
upgrades.desc: Rampages last much longer.

upgrades.name: EVOLVE: Apex Titan
upgrades.desc: Nothing in the city can stand before you.

upgrades.name: Tail Sweep
upgrades.desc: Turn hard and your tail whips behind you, cutting a band of floors out of whatever it hits so the floors above drop.

upgrades.name: Momentum
upgrades.desc: Hold a straight line to build speed: you hit harder, knock tanks flying and ram through blocks. Turning bleeds it.

upgrades.name: Shearing Tail
upgrades.desc: A longer tail that cuts higher: whole towers lose their upper floors.

upgrades.name: ULTIMATE: {beam}
upgrades.desc: Press E: a long beam from your maw, steered as you turn, that sets everything it crosses burning.

upgrades.name: City Ablaze
upgrades.desc: Your breath and beam set buildings alight, and fire spreads from building to building on its own. A burnt-out building collapses and pays biomass.

upgrades.name: Five-Alarm
upgrades.desc: Fires spread faster.

upgrades.name: Fire Front
upgrades.desc: Fire runs with the wind: buildings downwind catch much faster.

upgrades.name: Ember Rain
upgrades.desc: Embers leap across the streets to the next block.

upgrades.name: Firestorm
upgrades.desc: Explosive sites you set off start big fires.

upgrades.name: Scuttle
upgrades.desc: Faster legs and quicker strikes.

upgrades.name: Wing Buzz
upgrades.desc: Hold the leap button in the air to glide and steer; landing crushes again.

upgrades.name: Climber
upgrades.desc: Climb any building and fight from its roof; your weight breaks the top floors so towers fall from the top.

upgrades.name: ULTIMATE: Brood
upgrades.desc: Press E: lay eggs that hatch into elephant-sized young who eat the streets and fight the army.

upgrades.name: Hydra Limbs
upgrades.desc: Each level frees a tentacle that strikes on its own at whatever is near, in every direction.

upgrades.name: Squeeze
upgrades.desc: Slip through gaps between buildings instead of shoving through them.

upgrades.name: Grab and Throw
upgrades.desc: A limb seizes a tank, helicopter or car and hurls it where you face; a thrown tank goes off like a grenade.

upgrades.name: ULTIMATE: Corrosive Ink
upgrades.desc: Press E: spray ink all around; coated buildings dissolve and coated attackers die.
